Don't use type.display (landing only). → Long-form text</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-definition"><div class="odv-q">How are sizes and line heights defined?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A ratio, line heights in proportion</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Line height is a ratio, so it grows with the text.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main task? → Reading comfort</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where does type do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Articles and long text</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Type does its work in articles.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Long-form text</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="color"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="color-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Color</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 0 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="color-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="color-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which color roles does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Surface, text, action and status</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Reading needs few color roles.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What must the interface protect? → Rarely</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the color tokens: <a href="foundations/color">Color →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="color-definition"><div class="odv-q">How is the palette defined?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Neutrals and one brand ramp</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Warm paper neutrals and one ink ramp.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What should the brand feel like? → Long-form text</li><li>What is the main task? → Read start to end</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-count"><div class="odv-q">How far does the inventory reach?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only what today's screens use</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Actions are rare, so the components today's pages use cover them.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Rarely</li><li>Who maintains the system? → A small team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-definition"><div class="odv-q">How does a component earn its place?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A use scenario needs it</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A component joins only when reading needs it.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How long is one visit? → One sitting</li><li>What is the main task? → Read start to end</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-values"><div class="odv-q">When does a component get another look?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only when the meaning changes</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Pages stay calm when a component changes only with its meaning.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Present</li><li>Which outcome matters most? → Reading comfort</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where do components do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Articles</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Components sit inside and around articles.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Long-form text</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section></div>
